nodes.label: main()
nodes.desc: CLI entry point: signals, libvlc_new(), libvlc_InternalAddIntf(), libvlc_InternalPlay()

nodes.label: libvlc_InternalInit()
nodes.desc: Boots the module bank, loads plugins, then parses command line and saved config

nodes.label: module_LoadPlugins()
nodes.desc: Scans the plugins directory and populates the module bank

nodes.label: vlc_module_load()
nodes.desc: Generic capability loader: vlc_module_match() ranks candidates, probe() activates the winner

nodes.label: vlc_player_Start()
nodes.desc: Player state machine: opens next media and spawns an input thread per item

nodes.label: MainLoop()
nodes.desc: Input thread: builds access->stream and demux, then runs the control loop

nodes.label: stream_AccessNew()
nodes.desc: Loads an access module (file, http, dshow...) that yields a byte stream

nodes.label: demux_NewAdvanced()
nodes.desc: Sniffs MIME/extension then probes demux modules by decreasing score

nodes.label: input_EsOutNew()
nodes.desc: Elementary stream sink: receives ES records from the demuxer and spawns decoders

nodes.label: DecoderThread()
nodes.desc: One fifo thread per ES: loads the codec module, drains frames to aout/vout

nodes.label: aout_New()
nodes.desc: Audio output object: module_need('audio output') picks the platform sink

nodes.label: vout_Create()
nodes.desc: Video output object: vout_display_New() matches a 'vout display' module
